propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 corrupts Markdown content when converting to Jira wiki format: escaping arrows inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting comment terminators
A two-phase lexer must lock code blocks, HTML comments, and fenced content before classification to prevent corruption, then segment remaining text by blank lines and list items

The renderer must classify content in order (locked blocks, headings, code, tables, HTML tags, regex-dangerous prose) and only delegate safe prose to pandoc, with post-render code-preservation fallback
A 178-body deterministic corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose fixtures) must achieve >=0.90 body and >=0.95 character coverage ratios with dispatched-and-changed units
pypandoc-binary 1.15 must be added as a pinned optional dependency with platform-specific CI gates; missing pandoc returns identity with wiki_render_fallback event
